french_tuple: [verse number, 1-based token ordinal, 0-based Unicode code-point start, exclusive end] in verse reading text without notes/markup, trimmed. Apostrophes and internal hyphens retained.

relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 29 verses reviewed against the two pinned texts.
notes: Gen 9:2: Hebrew possessive fear of you becomes the French subject; do not equate the pronoun with a new lexical sense.
Gen 9:5: the added exhortation 'Sachez-le' is contextual; repeated idiom 'from the hand of' is represented by the French preposition.
Gen 9:10–17: repeated alliance partners and prepositions are compressed and the enumeration rearranged; preserve each original ID.
Gen 9:19: the source expression from these is expanded in the French as their posterity; preserve the contextual link without assigning a lexical sense of posterity to the preposition.
Gen 9:20: the idiom man of the soil is rendered as cultivate the soil; preserve the group, not an individual lexical sense of cultivate for man.
Gen 9:24–29: temporal conjunction, optative idiom, pronominal and compound-number expressions retain the source occurrences.
editorial_review.limitations: Same editor performed both passes; no certified dictionary sense; no automated tests. Publication checks remain separate.
